messages:
leah.peopleops: Quick update — we've published a policy change to the employee handbook: expanded paid caregiver leave + updated data-handling expectations. Please review and ACK by Tue 2025-11-04. Handbook PR and summary here: https://internal.redwood/repo/handbook/pulls/88 

maria-peopleops: Short FAQ added to the repo — highlights: US/CA changes effective 2025-11-01, EU operations should follow local regs (no global change). cc @jordan-hr for offer template note.

jordan-hr: Thanks — do managers need to update offer letters? I can push a template change if so.

sam.eng: Acked. Quick Q: what's the training deadline for the data-handling module?

leah.peopleops: Deadline for the mandatory micro-course is 2025-11-07. It's ~20 minutes and issues a certificate that auto-posts to People Ops. compliance-bot will send weekly nudges.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Training assigned — "Data Handling (v2)". Assigned to @all. Due in 14 days. Training link: https://training.redwood/assign/data-handling-v2.

alex-recruiting: Are contractors included in the mandatory ack/training? We have 3 contractors starting 2025-11-03 on eng.

maria-peopleops: Contractors: handbook read-only access only; mandatory certs apply to FTEs and payroll temps. Please add contractor names + start dates to the contractor tracking sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/contractor-tracker.

sam.eng: Managers — pls confirm you've added the course to your team onboarding checklist.

jordan-hr: I updated offer templates in the templates repo. Small change in `benefits_clause.md` — PR #42 with language referencing the updated caregiver leave.

maria-peopleops: I'll draft a short manager-facing email and host a 15-min Q&A this Friday 9:00am PT. If you want to co-present, ping me.

sam.eng: I'll forward to Eng managers and add to the managers channel. :thumbsup:

leah.peopleops: Thanks — I'll reconcile acknowledgements after compliance-bot's report next Monday and follow up with any outstanding teams. If any legal/regional questions come up, tag @jordan-hr and @maria-peopleops.
